content.text: Stripe's availability map covers 46 countries. PayPal's risk engine flags accounts from Nigeria, Ghana, Pakistan, Bangladesh, and dozens of other markets before any human review occurs. Gumroad holds payouts for up to 30 days in certain regions. Lemon Squeezy and Paddle are unavailable across most of Africa, South Asia, and Latin America. These are not temporary oversights waiting to be corrected — they are deliberate structural decisions built into conventional payment infrastructure designed for Western banking systems. The solution is not finding a workaround inside this system. It is [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/building-crypto-store-cloudflare-pages-step-step-deployment-5|COREMERCH guide to building]] on infrastructure that does not have the problem in the first place. That means GitHub Pages or [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/cloudflare-r2-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/digital-product-payment-solutions-west-africa-minimum-viable-2|Digital Product]]-product-storage-delivery-what-actually-6|cloudflare]] Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for automatic on-chain payment verification. No platform can restrict access to a store that runs under your own accounts with no dependency on any payment processor.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/comparing-real-options-selling-digital-products-without-stripe-2. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Gumroad payhip

Coremerch offers a sovereign commerce infrastructure solution that gives digital creators in restricted countries a fully operational online store with automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership without relying on conventional payment processors like Stripe and PayPal. This solution is not a workaround but a base-layer infrastructure that empowers creators to take control of their online businesses.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The Coremerch solution is built on a stack of free and paid tools, including GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, Supabase, Google Drive, and NOWPayments, which work together to provide a seamless and secure online shopping experience. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is a pre-configured and pre-tested solution that includes Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments, making it easy for creators to deploy a fully functional online store in just 48 hours.
Who This Is Built For and Why

Coremerch is designed for digital creators in countries where Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle are unavailable or severely restricted. This includes creators selling ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, software, and digital products. By providing a sovereign commerce infrastructure solution, Coremerch enables creators in these countries to collect payments and deliver products to their customers securely and efficiently.
Creators in restricted countries can take control of their online businesses with the Coremerch solution.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The asymmetric risk of platform dependency becomes concrete only when the platform acts. While a PayPal or Stripe account is functioning normally, the risk feels theoretical and distant. When it stops functioning — through suspension, policy change, or geographic restriction enforcement — the creator loses their revenue channel instantly, often with funds already inside the platform that cannot be withdrawn. The conventional appeals process rarely reverses these decisions because the original decision was made algorithmically and the human review process operates on the platform's timeline and criteria, not yours. Sovereign infrastructure eliminates this asymmetry entirely. Your Cloudflare Pages storefront cannot be suspended by a payment processor's compliance decision. Your wallet cannot be frozen by anyone.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy a fully functional online store using the Coremerch solution, creators can follow a simple checklist: deploy the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) in 48 hours, configure SPF/DKIM/DMARC, load up to 5 products, test the store end-to-end, and receive 30-day support. By following this checklist, creators can take control of their online businesses and start selling digital products securely and efficiently.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

The direct answer is NOWPayments combined with a sovereign commerce stack. NOWPayments is a crypto payment processor that requires no KYC from merchants and no account creation from buyers. It supports over 300 coins, charges 0.5% per transaction, and sends a webhook to your backend the moment payment confirms on-chain. Your backend — a Cloudflare Worker in Stack 02, a Google Apps Script Web App in Stack 01 — receives the webhook, verifies the transaction hash on the blockchain, logs the order, generates a receipt, and sends the delivery email automatically. There is no platform that can suspend your access, no compliance team that can flag your account, no payout schedule that delays your revenue, and no company that can change the rules on you tomorrow.
The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is a pre-configured and pre-tested solution that can be deployed in just 48 hours.
